Subject: Request: reversal of pilot promo credits (Invoice 443)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. We accepted the pilot stipend Redwood provided (applied as credits against invoice #443), but after a downstream audit our accounting team says the credits should not have reduced our payable — they need a formal credit memo or an AR netting entry so Zephyr's finance team can reconcile SAP.

- Invoice: 443 (net due $12,300 before credits)
- Pilot stipend applied as credit: $3,000
- We need either: (a) a credit memo referencing invoice 443, or (b) an internal netting entry so the invoices remain intact and we see a separate contra-credit in our system.

Can you advise how Redwood prefers to treat pilot credits from an accounting perspective and what docs you can issue? Attached is our invoice extract for reference.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our quarter close is next week.

Thanks,
Anna Morales

Zephyr Labs

Hi team — reviewed with Finance Ops and Tax. Proposed treatment below (recommended):

Proposal (preferred): AR netting (invoice offset) + internal memo
- Post a contra-AR credit of $3,000 linked to invoice 443 rather than issuing a traditional external credit memo. This preserves the invoice history for Zephyr and satisfies their SAP reconciliation requirement. Redwood books a contra-revenue allowance on GL 6401 (Promotional Allowances) and records contra-AR on AR clearing GL 1209.
- Journal entry (summary): DR Promotional Allowance (GL 6401) $3,000 / CR AR Clearing (GL 1209) $3,000.
- Tax: No sales tax adjustment necessary — this is a promotional allowance. Confirmed with tax team.
- Required docs: internal accounting note + exportable AR clearing line to send to Zephyr for their SAP upload. We can also produce a 'credit memo' PDF strictly for customer-facing reconciliation that references invoice 443 but marks the transaction as a promotional allowance (non-cash).

Alternative (if legal/ops insists on external CM): issue a formal credit memo referencing invoice 443 and route through DocuSign. That would hit the same promotional allowance GL but will create customer-facing credit documentation.

Next steps:
1) Vanessa — can you produce the AR clearing export and a one-page accounting note for Zephyr? I attached a draft workbook with the suggested entries (accounting_note_zephyr.xlsx).
2) If Karthik wants the customer-facing PDF, I can draft credit-memo-draft-443.pdf and route for approval.

I've cc'd Anna so Zephyr knows the path — Karthik, happy to proceed with netting unless you prefer a credit memo.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
